svg.text: Every session entry relocks security, re-entering the same session included.
Returning to default re-enables communication (0x28) and turns DTC setting (0x85) back on; extended <-> safety keeps them.
S3 (5 s by default) runs only while no exchange is in flight; 0x3E keeps the session. 0x27, 0x28 and 0x85 run only outside default.
Without [boot], 0x10 02 answers 0x12. With it, the handoff is accepted from extended unless its "0x10 02" row says otherwise.
A non-default session holds NM awake.
